places: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

fields.climate: varies from tropical monsoon in south to temperate in north
fields.terrain: upland plain (Deccan Plateau) in south, flat to rolling plain along the Ganges, deserts in west, Himalayas in north
fields.hazards: droughts; flash floods, as well as widespread and destructive flooding from monsoonal rains; severe thunderstorms; earthquakes; volcanism: Barren Island (354 m) in the Andaman Sea has been active in recent years
fields.resources: coal (fourth-largest reserves in the world), antimony, iron ore, lead, manganese, mica, bauxite, rare earth elements, titanium ore, chromite, natural gas, diamonds, petroleum, limestone, arable land
fields.farm: sugarcane, rice, milk, wheat, bison milk, potatoes, vegetables, maize, bananas, onions
fields.exports: refined petroleum, packaged medicine, diamonds, broadcasting equipment, garments
fields.industries: textiles, chemicals, food processing, steel, transportation equipment, cement, mining, petroleum, machinery, software, pharmaceuticals
fields.languages: Hindi 43.6%, Bengali 8%, Marathi 6.9%, Telugu 6.7%, Tamil 5.7%, Gujarati 4.6%, Urdu 4.2%, Kannada 3.6%, Odia 3.1%, Malayalam 2.9%, Punjabi 2.7%, Assamese 1.3%, Maithili 1.1%, other 5.6%…
fields.religions: Hindu 79.8%, Muslim 14.2%, Christian 2.3%, Sikh 1.7%, other and unspecified 2%
fields.legal: common law system based on the English model; separate personal law codes apply to Muslims, Christians, and Hindus; judicial review of legislative acts
fields.military: ages vary by branch of service and positions, but generally 17-27 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
